description: Bathroom leak upstairs — cold water supply pipe in the 1st-floor bathroom failed and leaked into the wall. Straightforward fix: opened the wall, replaced the failed pipe section like-for-like with sealing and standard insulation, ran a blower to dry it out, then closed and repainted the opening. Localised damage, nothing beyond the immediate wall patch. One firm did the repair and drying, the painter closed up. A couple of visits, all standard materials. Invoices came in as a few summary lines rather than fully itemised.

lines.1: Pipe repair – replacement pipe section (standard spec), sealing material and standard rock-wool insulation | 1 flat rate
lines.2: Installation and service-technician labour hours 1 flat rate
lines.4: Construction dryer flat-rate charge 1 flat rate
lines.5: Painting the disturbed wall area and closing the wall opening | 1 pcs
